phase: Phase 3 - Historical Data Acquisition & Label Alignment

1_existing_pipeline_compatibility.filter_logic: SUBBASIN == 'BB' (Bay of Bengal) only; 1589 BB storms in file; currently 1186 storms after temporal filtering in training (per README)
1_existing_pipeline_compatibility.target_generation: horizons [1,2,4,8,12] x6h = +6h,+12h,+24h,+48h,+72h; targets are future lat/lon pairs (10 values)
1_existing_pipeline_compatibility.timestamp_format: ISO_TIME parsed as UTC; IBTrACS 3-hourly natural interval (median 3.0h, 99.5% 3h per preprocess Step 4)
1_existing_pipeline_compatibility.sequence_construction: seq_length=4 consecutive observations (12h history) -> features [lat,lon,wind,pressure,dlat,dlon,speed_kmh,direction_deg,hour_sin,hour_cos] -> select 8 [0,1,4,5,6,7,8,9] (exclude wind/pressure 89% missing)
1_existing_pipeline_compatibility.geographic_assumptions: Lats 5-25N, Lons 78-98E for visualization; but filter is SUBBASIN BB only, not hard lat/lon clip; Phase 1 ROI 5-25N 78-98E matches
1_existing_pipeline_compatibility.cyclone_filtering: Drop invalid lat/lon, drop NA mandatory, dedupe storm_id+timestamp, require len >=16 (seq4+12)
1_existing_pipeline_compatibility.compatibility_notes: Future MOSDAC dataset must produce same 10 targets and be splittable storm-wise; satellite features will be auxiliary to the 8 kinematic features

Historical 2024 data exists on MOSDAC archive but requires authenticated download; not auto-verified here via direct HTTP but product docs confirm archive since March 2024

2_insat3ds_availability.overlap_with_labels: Only 2024 cyclones after ~2024-03 have potential overlap; 2023 has zero overlap (pre-launch)

5_satellite_track_temporal_alignment.mapping: satellite_timestamp (30-min) -> nearest cyclone-track timestamp (3-hourly) with tolerance; then build seq of 4 track states ending at matched track time, plus future targets +6/12/24/48/72h

tolerance_options.pros: Simple, compatible with existing 3h model, no interpolation, preserves observed targets
tolerance_options.cons: Up to 90m offset between satellite image and cyclone state; not all satellite timestamps map (only those near 3h marks, ~1/6 of 30-min)

tolerance_options.pros: Near-exact temporal sync, retains all 30-min satellite frames (6x more samples)
tolerance_options.cons: Interpolated targets not observed; introduces smoothing error for recurvature/intensity changes; deviates from observed IBTrACS evaluation

tolerance_options.description: Aggregate six 30-min satellite features to 3h by mean/median
tolerance_options.pros: Matches label cadence, reduces noise, temporal context 3h
tolerance_options.cons: Loses 30-min dynamics, adds aggregation complexity, still 1 per 3h

tolerance_options.description: Use 30-min satellite sequence (e.g., 6 frames) + interpolated future targets
tolerance_options.cons: Requires new model architecture (seq_len 6-12), not compatible with seq_len 4 3h model, major redesign

5_satellite_track_temporal_alignment.recommended_strategy: nearest_track +/-90 min - keeps existing model compatible, scientifically valid (90m < typical 3h motion ~50-100km, smaller than 81km error), avoids interpolated label leakage. Satellite features averaged over +/-15m window (single frame) at track time; no aggregation. Full 30-min dataset retained for future high-freq model but subsampled for initial experiment.

missing_handling.missing_track: Skip satellite timestamp if no track within +/-90m; do not fabricate; log as incomplete (like Phase1 hem/sst gaps)
missing_handling.missing_satellite: If 4-product not complete for matched track time, mark sample incomplete and skip or fallback to available products (CTP/HEM/SST) with missing_indicator; do not use incomplete for training until QA
missing_handling.sid_leakage: Use storm_id to group; never mix SIDs in one sequence
missing_handling.future_targets: Generate from IBTrACS at +1,2,4,8,12 steps (as in preprocess generate_sequences) - requires n>=16 per storm, else discard storm

6_label_generation_strategy.pipeline: satellite at t (nearest track +/-90m) + cyclone state at t (from IBTrACS) -> input seq length 4 (12h history, 3h steps) -> future targets +6/12/24/48/72h (steps 1,2,4,8,12)
6_label_generation_strategy.satellite_mapping: satellite_timestamp (30-min) -> nearest cyclone-track timestamp (3-hourly) with tolerance; then build seq of 4 track states ending at matched track time, plus future targets +6/12/24/48/72h
6_label_generation_strategy.missing_track: Skip satellite timestamp if no track within +/-90m; do not fabricate; log as incomplete (like Phase1 hem/sst gaps)
6_label_generation_strategy.missing_satellite: If 4-product not complete for matched track time, mark sample incomplete and skip or fallback to available products (CTP/HEM/SST) with missing_indicator; do not use incomplete for training until QA
6_label_generation_strategy.sid_leakage: Use storm_id to group; never mix SIDs in one sequence
6_label_generation_strategy.future_targets: Generate from IBTrACS at +1,2,4,8,12 steps (as in preprocess generate_sequences) - requires n>=16 per storm, else discard storm
6_label_generation_strategy.alternative_evaluated: interpolation, resample, retain 30-min seq - compared, nearest-track chosen for compatibility/validity

diversity.seasonal: 2024-05 Remal (pre-monsoon), 2024-08 monsoon depressions, 2024-10 Dana post-monsoon, 2024-11 FENGAL late season - good seasonal spread
diversity.intensity: Mix named cyclones (REMAL, DANA, FENGAL) and monsoon depressions - intensity diversity present
diversity.geographic: Lat 3.6-28.2, Lon 79-93 - covers BB basin well
diversity.autocorrelation_note: Sequences sliding-window from same storm are correlated (overlap 3 of 4 history); effective independent samples ~ n_events, not n_seq. Treat per-event counts as correlated.

minimum_experimental.interpretation: Pilot only, high variance, use storm-level CV

preferred.interpretation: 2024 INSAT-3DS overlap alone; sufficient for controlled experiment with storm-level split

robust.interpretation: Needs 2023 via 3DR reader + 2025 data + augmentation; avoids overfitting 31k params

7_dataset_size_analysis.assessment: 37x96 from Phase2 (20.5h single regime) insufficient. 2024 9-event ~258 sequences improves 7x; meets minimum for Phase4 pilot if labels aligned. Robust needs more history.

risks.name: Overlapping windows
risks.desc: generate_sequences uses sliding window step 1: sequences i and i+1 share 3 of 4 history obs. If split randomly, leak.
risks.mitigation: Storm-level split as in preprocess storm_split (70/15/15) - never split same SID across train/val/test

risks.name: Same cyclone in train+val
risks.mitigation: Strict storm_id grouping; Phase2 had 830/177/179 storms no overlap verified

risks.name: Future satellite leakage
risks.desc: Using satellite at t+30m as input for target at t
risks.mitigation: Only use satellite at or before track time t (causal). For aggregated resample, window [t-90m, t] not future

risks.name: Target leakage into features
risks.desc: Computing speed/direction that peeks at future
risks.mitigation: Derive dlat/dlon/speed only from past (as preprocess does); satellite features must be from t only

risks.name: Normalization leakage
risks.mitigation: Fit only on train (as Normalizer.fit does), transform val/test with train stats; include satellite features in same norm

risks.name: Duplication via interpolation
risks.desc: Interpolated track creates synthetic samples that leak across splits if storm split not respected
risks.mitigation: If interpolation used, still group by original SID and keep synthetic within same split

risks.name: Temporal autocorrelation inflated n
risks.mitigation: Report effective n = n_events; use group K-fold by SID

8_leakage_analysis.recommended_split: Cyclone-level (SID) split, not timestamp; 70/15/15 like existing, seed 42, verify no SID overlap; optionally event-level if cyclone has multiple close SIDs

useful: l1c_IMG_TIR1/WV/MIR_mean/std/min/max (brightness temp carries signal, but raw counts duplicate)
problematic: sst_FCT and VAR identical (r=1.0) - keep one
SST 91-93% pixel missing - raw mean unreliable
SWIR/VIS large variance due to day/night (not normalized)

candidates: TIR1 brightness temp gradient mag mean (edge strength)
SST ocean-only valid_fraction + SST gradient (instead of raw mean)
coldest_pixel lat/lon offset from ROI center (localization)
histogram 5-bin temp (distribution shape) vs single mean
proposed_spatial.note: All computable via lat/lon masked stats without resize; no new reader needed, but add to preprocess.py Phase4.

final_budget.target: 8-12 informative features for first controlled experiment
final_budget.rationale: Keeps p=12 -> p/n 0.046 for 258 seq, interpretable, covers IR, WV, cloud-top, precip, ocean. Avoid totals/duplicates. SST kept but masked.

9_feature_strategy.plan: Do not prune existing NPZ; design new Phase4 extractor that outputs 12-D vector per timestamp; keep 96 as reference; compare via ablation.

10_future_dataset_schema.description: One row = one matched satellite-track time t where future targets exist

fields.timestamp: ISO UTC of track time t (satellite matched within +/-90m)
fields.sat_timestamp: ISO UTC of satellite (30m) actually used

10_future_dataset_schema.storage: NPZ per split (like existing train/val/test.npz) with keys inputs (N,4,20) where 20=8 kinematic +12 satellite (broadcast over 4 steps or as static), targets (N,10), meta list
10_future_dataset_schema.compatibility: HORIZON_STEPS [1,2,4,8,12] unchanged; seq_length 4 unchanged; only input dim grows 8->20 (or 8+12 separate branch)

Label delay: IBTrACS 2024 data exists in raw ibtracs_NI.csv (checked 11 BB 2024 storms) - so labels ARE available for 2024, blocker from Phase2 (2026) not present for 2024. Need to confirm IMD vs IBTrACS timeliness for NRT.
Feature engineering: 96->12 reduction not yet implemented
Download automation: No API ingestion yet, manual MOSDAC portal download required for Phase4 pilot (estimate 9 events * ~35 timestamps *4 products ≈1260 HDF5 files ~15 GB)
Leakage-safe pipeline not yet built for joint satellite+track
12_phase4_prerequisites: Download 2024 BB cyclones (9 events) 3SIMG 4-product archive from MOSDAC for timestamps covering each storm period +/-1 day (scriptable via data_acquisition.py list).
Run Phase4 extractor: for each track obs, find nearest satellite +/-90m, extract 12 satellite features (ocean-masked), save per-timestamp NPZ as in Phase1 but aligned.
Build joint dataset: merge satellite 12-D with existing 8 kinematic per sequence, generate targets as in preprocess.generate_sequences, storm-level split.
Normalize satellite features with train-only stats (extend Normalizer).
Baseline check: train with p=12 vs p=8 alone, report Δ hybrid 81.2 km.
Add ocean mask for SST, handle VIS day/night, test resampling alternative as ablation.

Q1.question: Can we access historical INSAT-3DS data?
Q1.evidence: INSAT-3DS operational 2024-03 onward; Phase1 reader verified 3SIMG products HDF5 half-hourly; MOSDAC archive contains 2024; download requires auth but product exists

Q2.question: Can we correctly align it with cyclone tracks?
Q2.evidence: IBTrACS 2024 BB has 11 storms (verified via raw CSV), 9 feasible; nearest-track +/-90m method preserves existing 3h model; mismatch 30m->3h resolved via retention 16% without interpolation; no SID mixing

Q3.question: Can we obtain enough diverse aligned samples?
Q3.evidence: 2024 alone yields 258 sequences (9 events, seasonal/intensity diverse) meets minimum/preferred (150-258) but for robust 500+ need 2023 via 3DR or 2025; p/n for p=12 is 0.046 (good) vs 2.59 before; effective independent n~9 events still limited

13_final_decision.rationale: Q1 YES, Q2 YES, Q3 PARTIAL -> PARTIAL_GO to construct pilot dataset (2024 9-event ~258 seq, p=12) for controlled experiment; robust dataset requires additional history/3DR adaptation.
